newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raision Tehtaat Jan-Aug profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Raision Tehtaat Jan-Aug profit falls.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy on Tuesday said its January-August profit fell 17 percent but it expected full-year earnings to come out just below the year-ago level.

Raisio blamed high raw materials prices and low sale prices for mill products and animal feeds for a fall in profit before extraordinary items to 91.5 million markka ($20 million) from 110.1 million in the year-ago period.
Earnings per share fell to 3.51 markka from 4.84, with net sales up at 2.48 billion markka from 2.06 billion.
The result was fully in line with analysts' forecasts, which had seen a 92 million markka profit after financial items in a 75-98 million markka range.
"The financial result is expected to fall just slightly short of that for 1995," Raisio said in a statement. Last year it made a 141 million markka profit before extraordinary items.
Raisio said in June that it targeted profit matching the 1995 level; it said on Tuesday its price situation had improved since late summer.

On its new cholesterol-reducing margarine, Benecol, Raisio said exports "or other internationalisation" would not begin this year although preparations were underway and proceeding according to plan. ($ = 4.571 Finnish Markka)
